race.comment: RUINATION (4) was snagged back from the sticky draw and chipped away late with a respectable eighth to Cross Tasman over 1400m at this track in BM88 grade. Deep into the prep and expect to see him closer in the run today. Go close. DAMIEN (5) handy gelding resuming after being anchored with the big weights last time in. Fitted with the two solid trials and can sprint well fresh with the sting out of the ground. LIGHTNING GLORY (3) underrated gelding who warmed up late first up with a tidy fifth over 1250m at Randwick Kensington. Comes to hand quickly and gets out to his right trip with the tongue tie going on. LOVE SHUCK (6) caught the eye first up at ($101) with a surprise third over 1200m at this track, then faded quickly in the straight when last in The Kosciuszko over 1200m here. Minor claims. JUST RESPONSE (8) tongue tie and winkers go on first up with the two searching trials under his belt. Sits on the speed and can surprise some of his more fancied rivals.
